items.title: DaVita HealthCare (DVA) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
items.summary: DaVita HealthCare (DVA) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +0.25% and +0.61%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: DaVita (NYSE:DVA) Beats Q2 CY2026 Sales Expectations But Stock Drops
items.summary: Dialysis provider DaVita Inc. (NYSE:DVA) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 5.2% year on year to $3.55 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.02 per share was 3.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Fresenius Medical Care Shares Drop After U.S. Treatment Volumes Fall Further
items.summary: Shares fell, wiping out most of their gains since the start of the year, after the German dialysis specialist reported another decline in U.S. treatment volumes in the second quarter.

items.title: Buffett-Inspired ETF Owns Berkshire, Apple, Amex and Generates 15% Yield
items.summary: The VistaShares Target 15 Berkshire Select Income ETF has topped Berkshire stock’s return of 3% since March 2025.

items.title: Can Volume Growth and RPT Recovery Support DaVita's Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: DVA's Q2 results are likely to benefit from volume growth and RPT recovery, but payor mix pressure and spending on technology could limit margin gains.

items.title: DaVita (DVA) Reports Q2: Everything You Need To Know Ahead Of Earnings
items.summary: Dialysis provider DaVita Inc. (NYSE:DVA) will be reporting earnings this Tuesday afternoon. Here’s what you need to know.

items.title: Quest Diagnostics Raises 2026 Outlook as Testing Demand Accelerates
items.summary: DGX raised its 2026 outlook as testing demand surged, but lower-margin deals and rising project costs could temper the payoff.

items.title: Is DGX Stock Worth Buying After Its Strong 2026 Earnings Momentum?
items.summary: Quest Diagnostics' earnings beat, raised 2026 outlook and broad testing demand support momentum, but valuation, debt and margin pressure temper the buy case.
